newsitem.title: USA: American Drug adds vitamins to ADC line.
newsitem.headline: American Drug adds vitamins to ADC line.

text.p: American Drug Co said Friday it is introducing vitamins to its "ADC" line.
American Drug is a generic pharmaceutical company which is creating a new brand exclusively for the Russian market.
The vitamins will be marketed under the brand name "REVITALIZE" and will include a multi-vitamin/multi-mineral, children's and daily vitamin.
The Revitalize vitamin brings to 28 the number of over-the-counter healthcare products and prescription drugs that ADC has registered in Russia.
